title: Introduction to Distributed Systems
lead: Lecture 01: what a distributed system is, its six characteristics, advantages and challenges, transparency, the CAP theorem, the fundamental models (client-server, P2P, microservices; synchronous vs asynchronous; crash, omission, timing and Byzantine failures; security threats) and the Google, AWS and banking examples.
src: Source: Lecture 01 (module overview and Introduction to Distributed Systems). Sections marked [outline] explain topics the slides only name, at standard textbook level.
